reviews.text: Very happy that I’ve finally found a groomer for my Golden. She can be a bit nervous but was happy out with Kieran and he done a great job.
Love bringing  my dog lewie to kieran  he is so good

Molly loves her spa experience with Kieran who is always so attentive to her and takes plenty of time as Molly can be a bit nervous.
Great service and great value for money.

Excellent service. I have had both my dogs here numerous times and will continue to do so. The dogs are always quite happy and relaxed upon arrival and after their grooming. I would recommend Kieran 100%

I took my dog Bella to furry friends and they did a fantastic job. She looked and smelled amazing and was so relaxed there. I had been worried as she is quite nervous, but he took his time and gave her breaks and played with her to keep her calm. I couldn’t recommend highly enough.
Kieran is fabulous with our dog Blacky! She always comes back smelling amazing and is so happy with all the attention she receives.  Would highly recommend Furry friends grooming to all .

Furry friends grooming is amazing ,Kieran is absolutely fabulous at what he does and our dog Simba loves going to him.. we always get lots of compliments of how lovely he looks and smells when he returns from his little 5 star spa day. Would recommend to anyone looking for a groomer!
Kieran is Always professional, I am so happy with the job he does on Benji everytime.I would highly recommend Kieran to do a fab groom on your pet
